messages:
Alice Nguyen: Quick heads-up — I need to swap tonight's primary slot (22:00-02:00 UTC) due to a delayed flight. Can someone take the primary for that window? I'm happy to do a 20m handoff before I board.
Carlos Rivera: I can take primary for 22:00-02:00 UTC if Priya can be secondary. I'm at my desk until 21:45 UTC so I can grab a quick run-through. :+1:
Priya Patel: I can be secondary from 22:00-02:00 but I'll be on a customer call at 00:30-01:00 UTC — can't take pager then. Happy to be secondary otherwise. @Carlos do you want me as backup?
Ben O'Neill: If Priya has one short blackout at 00:30-01:00, we should confirm who is escalatable during that 30m. I can be reachable as emergency fallback from 23:30-01:30 UTC.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks all. Plan suggestion: Carlos primary 22:00-02:00, Priya secondary except 00:30-01:00, Ben emergency fallback for that overlap. Can folks ack so I can update rotation? Also adding quick runbook pointers below.
Alice Nguyen: Runbook snippet (quick paging checklist):
```
1) Check prod-alerts dashboard (dash.redwood.io/oncall)
2) If >2xx error spike, hit: ./tools/incident triage --level P1
3) Escalate to on-call pager if latency > 2s for 5m: /pager escalate primary -> secondary -> fallback
4) Use channels: #incidents + #eng-oncall, add tag :customer-impact:
```
Carlos Rivera: Acked. I can take the handoff at 21:40 UTC for 20m. I'll run through the KV-cache restart play and the quick diff to revert canary rollouts.
Priya Patel: Acked. I'll set my status to "secondary (22-02 UTC)" and add note about 00:30-01:00 blackout. Will forward any critical alerts to Ben during that minute.
Ben O'Neill: Acked. I can be on call as emergency fallback for the 00:30-01:00 window. If anything escalates to P0 during that time ping me directly (mobile).
incident-bot: Reminder: Please update rotation in the oncall scheduler. Use `/oncall swap` or update the handoff note in the channel.
oncall-bot: Action completed: Carlos Rivera set as primary for 2025-11-12 22:00-02:00 UTC. Priya Patel added as secondary (note: 00:30-01:00 blackout). Fallback: Ben O'Neill.
Carlos Rivera: Thanks — I'll post a one-line handoff summary in this thread after our 21:40 sync. Also tagging runbook owners: @Alice for KV-cache steps, @Ben for fallback routing.
Alice Nguyen: Appreciate it — leaving the laptop in the car. Handoff checklist in the thread when I'm wheels-up. :airplane:
Carlos Rivera: Quick HTO (handoff-to-oncall) summary after 21:40: confirmed canary queue empty, autoscale policies healthy, no open regressions in /rollouts. Primary switched to me at 22:00.
Priya Patel: Thanks team — leaving my contact and a short note: if you see repeated prefix cache misses, increase `cache_size` to 1.5x temporarily and report to infra.
Alice Nguyen: Thank you everyone. I'm good to go. Leaving a small sticky in the runbook with the infra link. :wave:
